design_philosophy: Anti-AI Slop, tactile children's book aesthetic combined with Brilliant.org-inspired interactive micro-learning logic. Soft playful palette, ultra-legible typography for early readers, chunky rounded cards with 3px deep-navy borders and offset pressable buttons. Voice-first guidance with speech bubbles and Web Speech API synthesis.
theme: Light, warm vanilla background with vibrant pastel pops

hierarchy.app_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-wide font-fredoka text-slate-900
hierarchy.speech_text: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-nunito text-slate-800 leading-snug

characters.name: Hoppy
characters.ears: long floppy lilac ears with soft pink inner ear pads
characters.svg_description: Inline hand-drawn styled SVG bunny with big round cheeks, cute twitching nose, lavender body, white tummy circle, and friendly wink

characters.name: Froggy
characters.personality: Master of the 6-box number line hops!
characters.svg_description: Inline SVG frog with rosy pink cheeks, wide happy mouth, mint-green belly, ready to spring along curved arrows

characters.name: Sunny
characters.personality: Loves counting more & less with stars!
characters.svg_description: Inline SVG cute yellow chick with feather tuft on top, coral pink wing accent, bright sparkling eyes

games.title: Missing Numbers
games.subtitle: Fill in the missing numbers (to 10)
games.description: Child sees 5 tiles with 1 or 2 missing numbers, direction indicator (COUNT FORWARD → / ← COUNT BACKWARD), speech audio, and 1-10 key pad.

games.title: More or Less
games.subtitle: Hop along the number line!
games.description: Number line with 6 boxes, START marker, Froggy hopping along curved arrows with white circle hop numbers (+1, +2, -1, -2), and 3 chunky choice buttons.

key_components.name: Header & Top Bar
features: App Logo with hopping bunny icon
Star Counter counter with pulse animation
Sound / Mute toggle (Web Audio API)
Grown-Up Corner Gate (3-second press and hold button)

key_components.name: Speech & Audio Bar
features: Character Avatar with talking mouth animation
Speech Bubble with clean high-contrast text
Big Yellow 'LISTEN' button with speaker wave icon
Web Speech API TTS reader with custom Web Audio synthetic fallbacks

key_components.name: Game 1: Missing Numbers Engine
features: Direction badge: BLUE [COUNT FORWARD →] or ORANGE [← COUNT BACKWARD]
5 horizontal chunky cards (blanks highlight with dotted outline)
1-10 on-screen number pad (56px+ touch targets)
Immediate tactile haptic feedback & sound effects
Progress dots indicator (6 puzzle steps)

key_components.name: Game 2: More or Less Number Line Engine
features: 6-box horizontal number line with START flag
Curved SVG arc with arrowheads depicting hop direction
White circle hop indicators (e.g., +2 MORE / -1 LESS)
Animated Froggy character hopping along the arc
3 big choice buttons at the bottom
Direction always uses both arrows and text (e.g. 2 LESS ←)

key_components.name: Celebration Screen
features: ALL DONE! Banner
Confetti canvas explosion
3 big animated gold stars
Replay game CTA & Return to Home CTA
Sound fanfare cheer

key_components.name: Grown-Up Corner (Parent Dashboard)
features: Press & Hold 3 Seconds Gate with progress indicator bar
Stats: Puzzles completed, accuracy %, stars earned, average time per puzzle
Reset progress button
Sound & Audio TTS settings
Pedagogical Grade 1 worksheet notes for parents

audio_system.engine: Web Audio API (Synthesizer for chiming notes, jumps, boings, win fanfare) + Web Speech API (SpeechSynthesisUtterance)
audio_system.speech_voice: Friendly high-pitched en-US voice selected automatically

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons are chunky (min-height 56px, rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl) with 3px solid #0F172A border and 4-5px hard offset box shadow (e.g. shadow-[4px_5px_0px_#0F172A] or custom inline style box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #0F172A). Active button presses down translate-y-1 shadow-[0px_1px_0px_#0F172A].
Load Google Fonts Fredoka and Nunito dynamically in index.html or top of App.jsx / App.css.
Implement hand-crafted inline SVG components for the 3 vector characters (Hoppy Bunny, Froggy Frog, Sunny Chick) with multiple expressions (neutral, talking, celebrating, thinking).
Ensure the Grown-Up Gate requires holding the button for 3 full seconds (with an animated filling ring or bar indicator) before opening the Parent Dashboard modal.

Always include clear data-testid attributes on all key elements: data-testid='home-screen', data-testid='game-card-missing-numbers', data-testid='game-card-more-or-less', data-testid='listen-button', data-testid='number-pad-btn-{n}', data-testid='choice-btn-{n}', data-testid='parent-gate-btn', data-testid='parent-dashboard', data-testid='sound-toggle', data-testid='star-count'.
Add Web Audio synthesized sound generator (zero external asset dependency) for tap sound, correct ding, wrong boing, and level complete fanfare.
Ensure the game is fully playable on mobile screens (responsive grid/flex layouts, scroll-proof 100vh container with touch-friendly spacing).
